name: Chicken and Croutons
description: A creamy chicken casserole topped with Swiss cheese and crunchy croutons.
recipeIngredient: 1 (10 oz) can cream of chicken soup

recipeInstructions.text: Rinse the chicken and pat dry, then arrange in a 9×13 inch baking dish.
Top each chicken fillet with a slice of Swiss cheese.
Combine the cream of chicken soup, mushrooms, and milk in a bowl; mix well.
Spread the soup mixture over the chicken.
Toss the croutons with melted butter in a small bowl.
Sprinkle the buttered croutons over the casserole.
Bake, covered with foil, for 1 hour.
Bake, uncovered, for an additional 15 minutes until the top is browned.

keywords: chicken casserole, croutons, creamy chicken bake
